gpu_tip: ~23GB total at 128K context. An i-quant: close to Q4_K_M quality at ~2GB less, imatrix-calibrated, at the cost of more CPU work per token, so it rewards putting as many layers on the GPU as will fit. A 24GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3090) holds it entirely; an 8GB GPU plus a 32GB DDR5 kit runs it.
mac_tip: Needs ~23GB — too tight for a 24GB MacBook Pro once macOS takes its share; a 32GB config (M4 Pro or M5 Pro) fits it comfortably.
